bibliographicQualifications.qualification: The linked Greg Pak collection describes material from Sword Master (2019) #1-6. The owner explicitly selects those six originals; progress remains whole-issue.
Correct the bibliographic typo without changing Shang-Chi (2020) #1-5.

The unnumbered linked title is the standalone The Legend Of Shang-Chi (2021) #1, issue 92003, series 31455, by Alyssa Wong and Andie Tong. It is source selection 4, not a seventh collected edition; collection metadata remains null.
The anthology is Marvel's Voices: Identity (2021) #1, issue 95679, series 32837. Only its Shang-Chi story is selected; no story-level progress is introduced.
The provider title is Shang-Chi and the Ten Rings (2022), series 35631. Preserve its original #1-6, followed by Shang-Chi: Master Of The Ten Rings (2023) #1, issue 103637, series 35648.
